title: Sents Africa
subtitle: Frontend for financial market insights
description: A frontend experience for exploring financial insights and publicly traded companies in Uganda and Kenya. The interface uses a dark, editorial visual system to make company information, market context, and research-oriented content easier to scan.
problem: Financial research interfaces can become dense and difficult to navigate. Sents Africa needed a clear way to introduce its market intelligence product, guide users into company discovery, and make complex information feel approachable on desktop and mobile.
role: Focused on the frontend implementation: landing page composition, responsive layouts, visual storytelling, dark-mode styling, data-oriented UI patterns, and the interaction details that support company and market exploration.
approach: Built the interface with React and Next.js, using a dark-mode-first design direction, green accent color system, responsive content sections, and data visualization patterns. The layout gives users a clear entry point before progressively introducing deeper financial information.
hardestDecision: Designing financial data visualizations that are informative without being overwhelming — finding the right level of detail for dashboards that serve both quick daily checks and deeper monthly reviews.
outcome: Live at sentsafrica.com as a frontend experience for Sents Africa's financial insights and publicly traded company research product.
whatIdChange: Would add automated bank statement imports, implement budget forecasting models, and add team collaboration features for shared financial reviews.
